title: cadintent common definitions
description: Shared scalar and reference types for the cadintent wire format. Spec version 0.1.0.

x-cadintent-quanta.description: Per-quantity quantum registry (v0). Quanta are spec-fixed (no per-project overrides); the project's unit system selects the column. Values quantize on entry with decimal ROUND_HALF_UP and are stored as quantized decimal strings in SI metres; equality in diff and conformance is exact string equality.

Ulid.description: A ULID in canonical 26-character Crockford base32 form. Object identity: minted by the author in the creating command, immutable for the object's life.

Ref.description: A payload reference to a design object: a single object ULID, or a selection ULID with an optional '#group' suffix naming one of the selection's groups. References are always by ULID, never by derived name.

GroupName.description: The name of a group within a selection, referenced as '<ULID>#<group>'.

Role.description: The closed set of author roles. Each command kind declares which roles may author it; enforced at fold time.

Author.description: Who wrote a command: 'role:identity', e.g. 'engineer:ricky' or 'agent:claude'. The role prefix is drawn from the closed four-role set.

CommandKind.description: A command kind name: lowercase dotted segments, e.g. 'project.units', 'object.create', 'civil.conduit.create'.

SpecVersion.description: The spec version a command was validated against, stamped per command. Cites the x-cadintent-spec-version carried by the schema files.

DecimalString.description: A quantized decimal number as a string. Quantized on entry to the quantum declared for its quantity in the x-cadintent-quanta registry (ROUND_HALF_UP); stored in SI metres where dimensioned. Never a JSON float.

PositiveDecimalString.description: A strictly positive quantized decimal string (e.g. a radius).

Sha256Hash.description: A content hash: 'sha256:' followed by 64 lowercase hex digits.
